text: Grandpa planted a tiny little seed.
"Grow, grow, little turnip!" he said.
The turnip grew, and grew, and GREW!
It was so big. It was ENORMOUS!
Grandpa pulled the turnip.
He pulled and pulled. But it would not come out!
Grandma came to help.
They pulled and pulled. But it would not come out!
The little girl came to help.
They pulled and pulled. But the turnip was still stuck!
Who should they call to help?
The dog came to help! Woof, woof!
They pulled and pulled. But it was still stuck!
The cat came to help! Meow!
They pulled and pulled. But it was still stuck!
Oh no, it is still stuck!
Who can help now?
The tiny little mouse pulled too.
And then... POP!
Out came the enormous turnip! Everybody tumbled down!
Hooray! They made yummy turnip soup.
Everyone shared together. The end!
It was getting dark.
"Let's try again tomorrow," said Grandpa.
So they all went inside for a warm, cozy supper. The end!
